item.title: ESB-MOT: One Restaurant Licence, Five Services
item.description: Tracing a single restaurant licence application through the Ministry of Tourism’s ESB platform, from a Nuxt form to a signed PDF, across five Spring Boot services and two Kafka hops.

item.title: ESB-MOT: Testing a Platform Spread Across Twenty Repos
item.description: MOT had no tests running in CI, and the defects that reached dev clustered at the boundaries between services. Notes on re-verifying a stale bug ledger, a stale department header, and a testing strategy built around where defects actually land.
